# FOO 0.4.0

**Release type:** FOO

**Git tag:** `foo-v0.4.0`

FOO 0.4.0 expands the language, standard library, compiler optimizer, project
workflow, diagnostics, editor integration, documentation, and release tooling.
It adds sentence-style function forms, defaults, named and variadic arguments,
scoped closures, plural bindings, richer types and collections, postfix failure
handling, benchmarks, selectable project entries, and live LSP feedback.

The runtime and compiler now include evidence-gated specialization, geometric
sequence growth, generated JSON codecs, local boundary elimination, synchronous
task specialization, profile-guided inlining, event-backed hosted task pools,
adaptive file and text paths, stronger cache identities, and detailed
optimization explanations. The documentation and registry site distinguish
implemented behavior from design work and cover the full beginner-to-advanced
path.

Linux x64 and ARM64 binaries are signed with the FOO release key. Verify the
detached signatures included beside each ELF binary using
`key.asc`, and verify every uploaded artifact with
`SHA256SUMS.txt`.

See `CHANGELOG.md` for the complete release notes.
